items.title: Predictive Maintenance at Scale with Treon Flow and AWS IoT Core
items.summary: Treon Flow extends Amazon Monitron sensor technology into a predictive maintenance solution on AWS, combining asset monitoring with machine learning analytics. In this post, we explore where industrial predictive maintenance is heading, from contextual analytics to automated maintenance workflows and technician productivity tools. We also look at how teams already using Amazon Monitron can extend their condition monitoring programs on AWS while keeping a familiar sensor design and ways of working.
items.creator: Parascovia Digori
